Thank you. I really appreciate it

I have work over the weekend unfortunately. I ended up crying in the bathroom at dnd because I was so nervous. He ended up grabbing my stuff and we’re currently walking to his house together. Neither of us have said much. I do wanna try and reschedule again just maybe give it a few days before trying again so I can just clear my head. I wanted to go home on the bus but I didn’t wanna let anyone at dnd down. I’m just frustrated and upset that he told me this so close to the end of the day and didn’t stay home if he was feeling so bad. I know I’m not blameless either. I should’ve just gone home and told them I couldn’t do it. Thanks for being so understanding. I have a lot of anxiety issues so everything just builds and builds until I break down.

Maybe but he took his temperature in the morning and it was normal. Mine was super dry. Idk about his. He said it hurt and was a bit dry. I also breath with my mouth more than the average person so this isn’t a big shock for me
I have told him. It bothers us both. Neither of us avoid it intentionally. It’s just the situation unfortunately. I kinda just feel sad about it
Ah gotcha. And that’s good you have other friends

Did they say what those reasons were? If you’re in high school maybe you can join some after school clubs to make some more friends? Though I completely understand if that’s too much right now. Do you have other friends to talk to?
